cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Gracious Command
cards.instruction: Remain warm and appreciative while steadily reducing everyone else’s room to choose.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Thank you for finding reunion venues. My garden will make everyone feel at home. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The hall has shelter if it rains.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Such thoughtful planning. I'll put a gazebo in the garden.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll keep the hall reservation as a backup.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're a lifesaver. Cancel it and put the deposit toward my gazebo; then we're all committed.

heightening.evidence: A5 turns the backup resource into funding that commits everyone to A option.
